author: TEDx Talks
description:
Kathleen's talk reveals how a technique large corporations use to manage billion-dollar risks can also handle life’s uncertainties— once streamlined for everyday use. She’ll share this simple yet powerful technique that anyone can adopt, illustrated by a very personal family story. Expect a fresh perspective for taming life’s worries and navigating its uncertainties.

Kathleen Culver is an educator, entrepreneur, and former tech professional who spent 35 years turning complicated ideas into practical successes at Bell Labs and Nokia. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How to manage life's risks like an engineer | Kathleen Culver | TEDxMontclair
